cohort: 100 healthy infants (1-12 months old) living in rural areas of Bangladesh
finding: 82% of infants had stool samples positive for 3GC-resistant E. coli, with a mean of 6.21 +/- 1.32 log10 CFU/g wet weight of stool; approximately one-third (33%) of total E. coli was 3GC-resistant, and almost 77% of those were MDR.
